title: The Last Signal Anew
author: Jude Crane
blurb: Lior Lockridge, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
